dominant: karuṇa (compassion) with śānta weight (redemption of the absent and the dead; rest in the installed form)
sthayibhava: karuṇa (compassion) in the guru's act of uplifting
justification: The ahnika redeems the absent and the dead through the guru's compassion; the installed form rests, and wonder at the net-practice crowns the rite.
